articles.title: Retired PSU employee faces ₹2 lakh tax demand over Form 16 omission; ITAT Pune grants relief
articles.summary: A retired PSU employee successfully challenged a ₹2 lakh tax demand after ITAT Pune ruled that a leave encashment exemption cannot be denied because it was omitted from Form 16. The Tribunal held that statutory tax benefits are determined by law and not by how the employer reports them.

articles.title: Can the government impose taxes without a law? What Article 265 says
articles.summary: Article 265 of the Indian Constitution states that no tax can be levied or collected except by the authority of law. In simple terms, every tax must be backed by a valid law passed by Parliament or a state legislature, preventing arbitrary taxation by the government.
